title: Huge glowing craft over the November 5 missile site
place_text: November 5 missile site, Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota

tellings.quote: The diameter of that thing was so big that it actually exceeded the perimeters of the fence line.

plain: Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran, says that in 1977 a huge glowing craft hung over a nuclear missile launch site called November 5. The site belonged to Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota. He says the thing was so wide it stretched past the fence line around the site. Woods tells it as someone who was there, with a fellow airman named Michael Johnson, and it would mean an unknown craft had come right up to American nuclear weapons.
